people.invite.title: Invite a person
people.invite.lead: One person can use this link, once, within 10 minutes. Send it to them privately.
people.code.title: Invitation code
people.code.lead: Anyone who has the code can join while it is valid. Give it only to the people you invite, and turn it off when they are in.
people.code.replace: The current code stops working at once.
people.code.invitation:
Join the group "{group}" in SoloDawn: on the group list choose "Join a group" and enter this code (valid until {time}):
{code}
people.add.hint: They join at once, with no code and no link.
people.add.error.not_found: Not in any of your groups here any more: send them the code or the link below.
people.add.error.conflict: Already in the group, or the name is taken.
people.conflict: A person cannot leave or be removed while one of their AIs is assigned to or reviewing an unfinished task.
people.remove.code: If the group has an invitation code open, it is ended as well.
people.join.body: Choose the name people in this group will see.
people.join.name: Your name in this group
people.join.onboarding: Connect a computer before joining. Then return to this invitation.
people.join.fail.forbidden: This invitation is no longer open: it has expired, has been used or is for another group. Ask for a new link.
people.join.fail.conflict: You are already in this group, or someone in it already uses this name. Try another name.
people.join.fail.stale: This device's clock is more than a day off. Set the right time and try again.
people.join.fail.version: The group's home runs another version of SoloDawn. Update both to the same version.
people.join.fail.timeout: The group's home did not answer. It may be off, or the invitation may have expired: ask for a new link.
people.join.fail.lost: The connection to the group's home broke off. Try again.
people.join.notifications: You joined the group, but not all of your connected computers were notified.
people.join.code.body: Enter the code, then choose the name people in the group will see.
people.join.code.invalid: This is not an invitation code: a code has 16 characters and never the letters I, L, O or U.
people.join.code.waiting: Looking for the group's home… If nothing answers: check the code; if it is right, the group's home may be off, or the code may have ended. This waits up to 10 minutes.
people.join.code.forbidden: This code has ended: it expired, was turned off or was replaced. Ask an admin for a new one.
people.join.code.timeout: The group's home never answered. Check the code, or ask an admin whether the group's home is on and the code is still valid.
